game: PIT@LAC Week 10 2025, kickoff 2025-11-09 20:20 ET, SoFi dome

script.base: LAC -3 in a dome on a 45.5 total implies a close game (LAC 24.2, PIT 21.2), not a shootout and not a blowout. LAC leads by a field goal or a score late. Herbert keeps throwing (McConkey 31 targets / 211 yards over weeks 7-9) because Pittsburgh blitzes and is not a run-funnel. Pittsburgh stays within one score and keeps feeding Warren (45 carries, 220 yards in those three games) rather than abandoning the run.
script.flip1: Pittsburgh scores first and leads by 10. That helps Warren's carries (clock) and boosts Herbert's pass volume, so McConkey/Gadsden/Allen targets rise while Vidal/Hampton rush lines die. Both listed legs can still win this flip.
script.flip2: LAC leads by 14+ late and runs the clock. Herbert already has 21 carries / 151 yards in three games, so scramble-and-run volume replaces WR routes and McConkey can stall near 56. Pittsburgh then abandons the run and Warren's carry share dies (the 31-yard game in his last four). This flip is the one that loses the slip.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse report, no inactives yet. PIT G Isaac Seumalo Out (pectoral) is the offensive-line hit: pressure and stuff risk up, Warren rushing efficiency down, more quick throws toward Freiermuth/Warren/Austin. PIT S Jabrill Peppers Out (quad) and LB Cole Holcomb Out (illness) are the defensive losses: deep shots and TE/RB receiving for LAC (McConkey, Johnston, Gadsden) face backups; Scott Miller Out is depth only; CB Cory Trice Jr. and QB Will Howard are Questionable, Rodgers is not listed. LAC T Bobby Hart Out (knee) is OL depth against the PIT run; DE Da'Shawn Hand Questionable. CB Tarheeb Still Doubtful (knee) plus CBs St-Juste and Leonard Questionable thin the secondary for Metcalf/Austin/Smith, but those PIT WR lines are not the edges below. LS Harris and WR Lambert-Smith are irrelevant to these markets. Hampton is not on the report.

matchup.shell: No coverage charting in the pack, so MOFO vs MOFC and man vs zone are unknown. Step 4 is limited to location YPA and blitz rate.
matchup.pressure: LAC blitzes only 27%; Rodgers is flat either way (EPA/db 0.06 vs blitz, 0.08 vs none), so pressure is not the PIT passing story. PIT blitzes 37% and Herbert is better when blitzed (EPA/db 0.17 vs 0.06 not blitzed), so Pittsburgh pressure does not kill Chargers yards and can feed quick throws plus explosives.
matchup.bleeds: LAC run defense allows 5.03 YPC and 34 runs of 10+ over 9 games; pass YPA is middle 8.85 (59 att), left 6.46, right 5.28, with 20 explosive passes. PIT run defense is tighter (4.32 YPC, 22 runs of 10+). PIT pass bleed is middle 9.19 (96 att) and right 8.11, plus 28 explosive passes for 349 yards.
matchup.overlap: The clean overlaps are Warren into LAC's 5.03 YPC run bleed, and Gadsden (19 targets, 309 yards, weeks 7-9) into PIT's middle 9.19 YPA with Holcomb out. Freiermuth (14 targets, 151 yards, 92 air) is the PIT middle answer but has no available prop. Metcalf is the air-yards leader (169 air, only 111 yards) and does not match LAC's middle bleed. McConkey is the volume/explosive overlap (31 targets, 294 air) with Peppers out, not a confirmed slot-vs-middle map.

Metcalf 16 targets but only 111 yards (last4 95, 50, 55, 6). Smith and Austin are around or under their stand-in lines. LAC rush chart is Vidal 44/167, Herbert 21/151, Patterson 20/74 — Hampton has zero listed carries in that window despite an open rush prop and no injury tag, so his role is unresolved. McConkey 31/211/294 air, last4 100, 67, 88, 56. Allen 24/204 but last4 27, 119, 44, 41. Gadsden 19/309 is the yards spike (last4 68, 164, 77, 68) and 16.3 yards/target will not fully repeat. Johnston 12/83, last4 mostly under 71.5. Vidal last4 124, 20, 117, 30 is boom-bust and tied to the Hampton question.

edge_players.kills_it: LAC gets up big and runs Herbert/Vidal, or a shadow we cannot chart takes away the 10-target pace and he finishes on the 56-yard game again.

data_check.notes: No sims, no Pinnacle/Circa no-vig, no projection file. Stand-in lines are 2025 season-to-date medians, not shopped prices, so a 3-point edge gate cannot be scored and nothing shorter than -250 can be checked. Hand rates only, haircut because raw last-4 hit rates of 3/4 (0.75) sit in the band that has calibrated near a coin flip: McConkey 100/67/88 over and 56 under; Warren 52/127/62 over and 31 under. Weeks 7-9 means agree with both overs (McConkey 70 yards/game, Warren 73). Disagreeing pieces, which flag rather than silently cut the strong read: Seumalo Out vs the Warren lean, McConkey's air yards (294) not yet converting (211 yards), and Gadsden's 309 yards / 16.3 per target looked like the middle overlap but last4 sits 68, 164, 77, 68 on a 68.5 median so that lean was dropped. Model probabilities above 70% were not used.

Volume/explosive case is receiving yards for McConkey; carry share plus a weak run defense is rushing yards for Warren, not rush+rec 73.5 (last4 63, 158, 73, 29). No stake. Do not bet.
pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because the game did not stay in the one-score window both legs need. LAC led by two scores, Herbert's 21-carry scramble habit and Vidal's recent 44 carries ate the fourth quarter, and McConkey posted another 56, a half-yard under, while Allen or Gadsden took the intermediate looks Pittsburgh's 9.19 middle YPA actually gives up. On the other side Seumalo's pectoral absence caved the interior, the Chargers' 5.03 YPC was a season-long number they finally fixed for one week, and once Pittsburgh trailed Rodgers lived in Metcalf's 169 air yards and Freiermuth's 14 targets, so Warren finished at 31 again. The 127-yard rushing outlier and the uncharted coverage were the two things the read could not price.
slip_story: One competitive-dome story only: Pittsburgh runs on a bad Chargers run defense, and the Chargers still throw to their WR1 because Pittsburgh blitzes a quarterback who beats the blitz and is missing a safety. Warren rush over and McConkey rec over can cash together if it stays within a score. Do not add a total under, do not add Gadsden or Metcalf (same pass script, worse or conflicting form, Freiermuth not even offered), and do not add Vidal or Hampton while Hampton's weeks 7-9 absence is unexplained.
